verdict: v0.5.17 AND dev-20260818-c0b6474b both rejected at live admission (quant-config load); selected the official day-0 Lightning image (dev-nemotron3-5-lightning).
root_cause: The Lightning checkpoint stores ModelOpt quant metadata solely in hf_quant_config.json (quant_algo MIXED_PRECISION: W4A16_NVFP4 experts + FP8 layers + FP8 KV). v0.5.17 and dev@c0b6474b both fall through to ModelOptFp4Config.from_config, which rejects MIXED_PRECISION (ValueError at model load). Upstream main gained resolve_checkpoint_quant_spec() only after 2026-08-18 (observed on main a3e4592f, 2026-08-20); no published cu13 image carries it yet. The purpose-built day-0 image (dev-nemotron3-5-lightning) is the newest published image that serves this checkpoint (proven by the prior MTP EAGLE s=3 campaign).
